treaty_name: Convention between Australia and the Republic of Italy for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion, with Protocol (1982)
eif_quote: [Treasury] Italy | DTA | 14/12/1982 | ... | In force | 05/11/1985 | Art. 29(2): "The Convention shall enter into force on the date of the exchange of instruments of ratification and its provisions shall have effect- (a) in Australia- (i) in respect of withholding tax on income that is derived by a non-resident, in respect of income derived on or after 1 July 1976; ... (b) In Italy- in respect of income assessable for taxable periods beginning on or after 1 January 1976."

rates.quote: Such dividends may be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident for the purposes of its tax, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

Such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

Such royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

Such dividends may be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident for the purposes of its tax, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

Such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

Such royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Not modified by the MLI (Italy has not listed the Australian treaty / Treasury does not mark it MLI-modified; map_CD mli_covered_both=false). No PPT in the treaty.

notes: Rates symmetric; entries split by source State only because the retroactive start dates differ (Australia 1 July 1976, Italy taxable periods from 1 January 1976). Art. 11(3): interest derived by governments, public bodies and central banks exempt (not modelled). Protocol para (8): negotiation-only MFN if Australia later grants an OECD State lower dividend (company), interest or royalty rates - no automatic change (not modelled).
